title: Migration options for the orders table

blocks.markdown: We looked at two ways to move the orders table. Both were rehearsed, and each has a cost.

blocks.title: Dual write, then backfill
blocks.markdown: No downtime; two weeks of double writes and a reconciliation job.

blocks.title: Snapshot, then cutover
blocks.markdown: One 20 minute window; the rehearsal took 17 minutes.

blocks.prompt: Should we also book a maintenance window now?
